newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Coronation forms jv, plans 1.25 bln rights.
newsitem.headline: Coronation forms jv, plans 1.25 bln rights.

text.p: South African fund management company Coronation Holdings Ltd said on Thursday it had agreed to create a new investment company, African Harvest Ltd, with National Empowerment Corp.
African Harvest, which will have a capital base of one billion rand, will be jointly controlled by NE Corp and Coronation via a holding company, African Harvest Holdings (Pty) Ltd.
"African Harvest will seek to acquire significant strategic investments in growth and empowerment companies in South Africa," Coronation said in a statement.
The company also said it aimed to raise some 1.25 billion rand before expenses by way of a renounceable rights offer of new "N" (non-voting) shares.
African Harvest Ltd planned to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange, NE Corp chairman Mashudu Ramano said in a statement.
Of the funds raised by the rights issue, 250 million rand would be retained by Coronation, while 700 million would be invested in African Harvest via its holding company, Ramano said.
A 200 million rand participation in Coronation Investment Trust would be transferred to African Harvest.
"The investment in Coronation Investment Trust, a hedge fund, will enable investors in African Harvest to participate in all financial markets," Ramano said.

Half of the remaining 100 million rand would be placed with private investors from South Africa's black community while the balance would go to union retirement funds and the newly-launched South African Empowerment Fund (SAEF).
Registration for the rights offer will close on July 11, 1997.
African Harvest would target investments in the financial services and consumer goods sector, Ramano said.
"African Harvest will in future widen its shareholder base progressively through a retail mechanism," he added.
NE Corp was formed in 1996 as a black economic empowerment vehicle with a network of 30 shareholder organisations. It holds three percent of Johnnies Industrial Corp Ltd (Johnnic) .
Coronation had a group net asset value of over 1.1 billion rand as at March 3. Its funds under administration total roughly 18 billion rand.
